content: The PnTxFilter of [SWS_CANIF_00747] shall only have an effect and transition its modes (enabled/disabled) if more than zero Tx L-PDUs per CAN Controller are configured as CanIfTxPduPnFilterPdu (see CanIfTx- PduPnFilterPdu ).

The PnTxFilter of [SWS_CANIF_00747] shall only have an effect and transition its modes (enabled/disabled) if more than zero Tx L-PDUs per CAN Controller are configured as CanIfTxPduPnFilterPdu (see CanIfTx- PduPnFilterPdu ).

The PnTxFilter of [SWS_CANIF_00747] shall only have an effect and transition its modes (enabled/disabled) if more than zero Tx L-PDUs per CAN Controller are configured as CanIfTxPduPnFilterPdu (see CanIfTx- PduPnFilterPdu ).

The PnTxFilter of [SWS_CANIF_00747] shall only have an effect and transition its modes (enabled/disabled) if more than zero Tx L-PDUs per CAN Controller are configured as CanIfTxPduPnFilterPdu (see CanIfTx- PduPnFilterPdu ).
